authorization: Bounded standalone M15 / H1 entry-filter research on entire available 2023; Draft PR only.

rules.calendar: Accepted historical research windows 10:00-14:00 and 14:05-18:50 MSK; PM starts14:15 during 2023-03-13 through03-20. Weekdays excluding accepted holidays. These are restricted historical research windows, not certification of full venue calendar. Wall alignment excludes PM14:00 and tail18:45 parent. Calendar-year2023 entire original M5 prefixes only.
rules.composition: Wall-clock M15/H1 from exactly 3/12 existing consecutive M5 within one approved continuous window. No partial parent, interpolation, native TF reads or session/gap bridging. Parent available last child start + scenario delay: M15 T+20/25, H1 T+65/70. Positive Volume required for every child for usable indicators/context/execution.
rules.cost: C1=historically applicable tick of each executed entry and exit side (CNY switch2023-09-27 19:00). C2 replaces C1 by2*C1 on identical executions and frozen levels; no new fills/filter/target. UNKNOWN total Net/cost/R null. Conditional normalized quote units only, no actual capital/GO/fill claim or cross-instrument monetary sum.
rules.cycle: Strict BB contained within KC. Episode range includes only its true squeeze candles from first through last. First false releases confirmed episode; its or later false Close outside original range gives symmetric LONG/SHORT expansion. Signal bar excluded from range; equality/inside waits. First direction consumes cycle regardless of filter/busy/nonfill. New squeeze expires unused prior range.
rules.entry: Decision at completed M15 availability. Submit exact first wall-clock M15 Open strictly later, T+30 for bothT10/T15. No lookahead existence filter, retry or price guarantee. At completed target observation, conditional Open must be on grid, strictly beyond edge, within inward rounded edge+direction*0.5*signalATR; risk>=4 dated ticks; Take distance<=3signalATR. Same geometry checked at signal Close before submission. Common safety cutoff target+25min<=flat_slot-5min for both scenarios.
rules.exits: Delivered M15 Close inside inclusive original squeeze range requests exit at next strictly future M15 Open. MAX_HOLD fixed120min: timer request entry+115min -> entry+120 Open. Session common flat_slot=floorM15(B-10min-25min), request flat_slot-5min; AM13:15/PM18:15 execution, acknowledgements no laterB-10 on complete parents at both delays. Session priority and earliest pending target retained. No BE/trailing. Resident protection precommitted, never uses a newly observed feature retroactively.
rules.freeze: Preregister config and technical feasibility before first P&L; no parameter changes on returns. Prior M5/M30 code/config/results/audits remain byte-identical. No Stage3/WF/OOS/LIVE/merge.
rules.h1_filter: Only entry admission differs. At signal availability, latest expected pair of adjacent clock-aligned H1 parents within same window, fully12-child delivered. Both C>O with second C>first C =>+1, symmetric=>-1, else0. Reject only sustained adverse trend; unknown/unready rejects. All expected M5 from first parent through latest child available by decision must exist with positive Volume; no stale fallback or bridging gaps. No H1 indicator warmup or signal/exit changes.
rules.metrics: All12 calendar months, expected M5 source slots and M15 eligible slots. NO_COVERAGE/pre-inception, PARTIAL_LAUNCH, PARTIAL_DATA and UNKNOWN labelled. Full annual Net/PF/DD null for any incomplete month/path. Closed-only diagnostic Gross/C1/Net/PF/expectancy/NetR, realized acknowledgement-order DD, conservative reached+3R, LONG/SHORT, daily/monthly counts and concentration. No favorable Stop/market exit-bar extrema in MFE. C2 monthly and direction results required.
rules.minimum_squeeze: 2 consecutive ready M15 candles=30min. Two observations establish persistence rather than a one-bar compression at the coarse frame. This is deliberately longer than M5 three-bar15min and fits the short windows; no returns consulted. First ready at seventh candle; earliest second squeeze eighth, breakout ninth.
rules.missing: An incomplete/absent exact target parent gives UNKNOWN_POSSIBLE_ENTRY_FILL (not zero/nonfill): null entry/quantity/payoff; blocks new entries until conditional emergency reduce-all at an observed complete allowed future M15 Open. Missing exposed full M15 parent => UNKNOWN and emergency reduce-all; past Net/R/cost remain null after later conditional flat. Boundary breach remains UNKNOWN liability; no automatic overnight flat. A complete target that fails causal price geometry is NONFILL. No incomplete parent admitted as a trading candle.
rules.period_justification: 7*M15=105min versus20*M5=100min. Fixed technical seed; not tuned on returns. BB7 current population variance; EMA7 SMA first7 seed alpha2/8; Wilder ATR7 first7 TR average (first TR=H-L), thereafter(6*ATR+TR)/7. Reset at missing/invalid parent, every window/day.
rules.protection: Resident committed Stop/Take evaluated exclusively on M15 OHLC; Stop-first on ambiguous dual touch; adverse Stop gap at worse Open; no favorable gap credit. Entry-bar Take forbidden; later Take needs one dated tick penetration. Scheduled market Open exit takes priority over that bars intrabar protection. OHLC outcomes conditional, no guaranteed real execution.
rules.stop_take: Initial structural Stop=edge-direction*0.25signalATR rounded LONG up/SHORT down, frozen before entry. At actual conditional M15 Open risk=direction*(Open-Stop), Take=Open+direction*(3risk+2dated entry ticks), rounded outward. Planned Net Reward/risk>=3 after C1. Stop never adjusted. Coefficients retain economic structure from prior hypothesis; no tuning to new returns.
